summary: Rebuild workspace crates after restoring CI dependency caches so generated-client checks use current source

rules.detail: No runtime or policy rule changes.

compatibility.detail: Dependency cache restoration discards workspace fingerprints and outputs while retaining third-party dependencies. Exact-source build snapshots use a new cache namespace to exclude previously cached stale workspace outputs.

downtime.detail: No runtime deployment or migration changes.

recovery.detail: A missing exact-source build snapshot rebuilds workspace crates rather than trusting dependency-cache timestamps.
